notes: NUZU 2.4 - made with Argus 1.0.3. The site rebuilds about every 10 minutes while a refresh run is going (up to 5.5 hours per run). A story found in two sections shows once, with an 'also in' tag. 141 outlets' own feeds (BBC, NPR, Guardian, Al Jazeera, DW, France 24, CBC and more) so their headlines open the article directly; Google News stays as the fallback. The top bar has the same order and look as Party Portal's. The silent video tiles pause while the page is hidden; the one being heard keeps playing. health.json is written each build.
